visa.NZ: Most people start on an Accredited Employer Work Visa with a job offer from an accredited employer. Some occupations are on the Green List, which can lead to residence sooner. Check your occupation's Green List tier, wage rule and any registration needed before the visa is granted.
visa.CA: Express Entry (Federal Skilled Worker, Federal Skilled Trades or Canadian Experience Class) plus category-based draws for some trades, healthcare and education occupations, or a provincial nominee program. Categories and eligible occupations change, so check the current list.
visa.AU: The employer-sponsored Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) uses the Core Skills Occupation List. Skilled permanent visas are points-tested or nominated. Most occupations need a positive skills assessment from the assessing authority named for that occupation.
